title: Is Trump’s AI obsession walking the world into disaster? – podcast
summary: Tech bosses have called for a slowdown in artificial intelligence and the creation of formal guardrails from the US government. But why is President Trump unmoved by the doomsday predictions,…
byline: Presented by Jonathan Freedland, produced by John Rogers and Nada Smiljanic; the executive producer is Maz Ebtehaj

blocks.text: Tech bosses have called for a slowdown in artificial intelligence and the creation of formal guardrails from the US government. But why is President Trump unmoved by the doomsday predictions, dismissing them as a ‘hoax’? What lies behind his embrace of the AI industry? Jonathan Freedland speaks to the Guardian US tech editor, Blake Montgomery
